title: Seeing the Goal, Missing the Truth: Human Accountability for AI Bias.

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing intermediate measures (sentiment and competition scores) generated by an LLM from earnings call transcripts under two prompt conditions: 'goal-blind' (control) and 'goal-aware' (treatment, where the downstream use for predicting stock returns or earnings is explicitly disclosed), and evaluating the resulting differences in predictive performance and out-of-sample generalization.
